sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints: license loss, seat belts and impaired driving

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
DWAI and DUI are different charges: DWAI means impaired even slightly, DUI means substantially unable to drive safely, and DUI per se is based on BAC above 0.08%. [A01]
Why it matters: group impaired driving; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F16 vs sec02-F18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
The revocation BAC level depends on the driver: over .08 for most adults, over .02 for drivers under 21, and over .04 for CDL drivers. [A01]
Why it matters: group impaired driving; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F19 vs sec02-F18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Seat belts are required for the driver, front-seat passengers and children under 16, but delivery-van drivers are exempt only while on the job. [A01]
Why it matters: group occupant protection; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F04 vs sec02-F05. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
The rear-facing rule for a child under 2 turns on weight: under 40 pounds means rear-facing in the back seat, while 40 pounds or more allows rear-facing or forward-facing. [A01]
Why it matters: group child restraints; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F07 vs sec02-F08. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A01
The 20-pound minimum belongs to the age 2 to under 4 band, while the 40-pound minimum belongs to the age 4 to under 9 band that allows a booster seat. [A01]
Why it matters: group child restraints; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F09 vs sec02-F10. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A01
A standard drink is the same alcohol whether it is 12 ounces of beer, 5 ounces of wine or 1.5 ounces of spirits, so switching drink types does not make you safer. [A01]
Why it matters: group alcohol; difficulty two; prereq sec02-F20. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A01
BAC drops only with time, at about 0.015% per hour on average; nothing else speeds it up. [A01]
Why it matters: group alcohol; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F22 vs sec02-F21. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
The first DWAI is the only listed impaired-driving conviction measured in points, 8 of them, while a first DUI brings a 9-month revocation instead. [A02]
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F23 vs sec02-F24. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
Revocation length climbs with repeat convictions: 9 months for a first DUI, 1 year for a second DWAI or DUI, and 2 years for a third or later. [A02]
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty three; confusable sec02-F24, sec02-F25, sec02-F26. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A02
For drivers under 21, a first DUI or DWAI leads to revocation only if the court-ordered evaluation or program is not completed, but a second or third is always revoked. [A02]
Why it matters: group under-21 rules; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F27 vs sec02-F28. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A02
Legal or medical use of a drug does not excuse impaired driving; prescription, over-the-counter and medical marijuana impairment are all penalized like alcohol. [A02]
Why it matters: group drugs; difficulty two; confusable sec02-F29 vs sec02-F30. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0007]

Misconception: you can only be convicted of impaired driving if a chemical test shows a high BAC; behavior and field sobriety tests also count. [A01]
Misconception: beer is safer than liquor; a standard drink of each holds about the same alcohol. [A01]
Misconception: a medical marijuana card is a defense to an impaired-driving charge; it is not. [A02]
Mnemonic: Twelve-Five-One-and-a-half for beer, wine and spirits, all one standard drink. [A01]
Glossary: BAC means Blood Alcohol Concentration, the share of alcohol in the blood. [A01]
Glossary: DWAI means Driving While Ability Impaired; DUI means Driving Under the Influence. [A01]
Glossary: Revocation means the license is taken away for a set period and must be reinstated. [A02]
Glossary: Booster seat means a raised seat that positions a child so the adult belt fits correctly. [A01]
